Implemented `refund_shipping(payment, amount, at)` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`:

- Validates and normalizes the timestamp and amount.
- Rejects non-positive amounts with `BillingError("non_positive_amount", ...)`.
- Only allows captured (or already partially refunded) payments.
- Prevents total refunds from exceeding the captured amount.
- Accumulates `payment.refunded_amount` and sets status to `"refunded"` when fully refunded.
- Records an audit event and returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, including additional edge-case checks.
